title: Beyond the Surface: Enhancing LLM-as-a-Judge Alignment with Human via Internal Representations

layout.note: Two panels side by side, split by a vertical dashed line. (a) is a symmetric top-down problem scene: prompts A and B feed one robot, which hands the same score to two outputs, each above its own histogram, with a verdict band underneath. (b) is a top-down method: prompt and robot on top, a decoder-only chain inside a rounded frame, a dashed wedge opening one block into a layer chain, dotted arrows to a wide LM_Head, a logit bar, a formula box and the final score.

lesson: Expose a hidden difference with a two-case problem panel: two cases with the same surface output, a small histogram under each output, and a tick or cross against the reference. Then draw the fix as one model chain, a zoom wedge opening the repeated block, and dotted taps from every layer to a shared head.
